figures.before: Industrial Product Types and Their Construction Specifications
figures.alt: Tilt-up industrial shell with dock openings, paved apron, demising bay, and stormwater inlet
figures.caption: Industrial value is rooted in the operating shell: access, circulation, truck courts, dock configuration, clear height, structure, utilities, drainage, fire protection, and the space needed for the tenant’s operation.

figures.alt: Industrial site grading with a stormwater basin, controlled slopes, compacted subgrade, and clear perimeter access
figures.caption: Site selection has to account for drainage, soils, utilities, access, grade, entitlement, environmental conditions, building pad, truck circulation, and the work required to make the property buildable.

figures.before: ESFR Sprinkler Design, Clear Height, and Column Spacing as Investment Drivers
figures.alt: Institutional warehouse with high clear height, ESFR sprinkler infrastructure, high-bay lighting, wide grid, and dock doors
figures.caption: Clear height, sprinkler approach, column grid, storage layout, lighting, docks, and the operational system are linked. They need to support the intended tenant rather than just meet a generic building description.
